## Custom GUI Mod v1.2.4

### Added
- Added configurable rune purchase resource and per-attempt cost for rune status 1 (Poison).
- Added server-authoritative affordability checks and spending through the shared resource system.
- Added client synchronization for the actual purchase resource and unit cost shown in the rune GUI.
- Added configurable purchase event multipliers, including global and per-status modifiers.
- Prepared awakening and upgrade economy rules with configurable resource, `FIXED`, `BY_RANK`, and `FORMULA` calculation modes, plus event multipliers.
- Added regression coverage for purchase, awakening, upgrade, duplicate-compensation, and event-modifier rules.

### Fixed
- Rune purchase buttons now display the server-synchronized price instead of relying on a client-side hard-coded value.
- Purchase pricing is scoped to the supported status collection so legacy collections keep their existing behavior.
- Rune purchases no longer depend on a hard-coded coin balance in the Poison purchase flow.

### Other
- Poison rune purchases still default to 100 coins per attempt.
- Duplicate compensation remains independent from purchase spending and continues to grant the configured rune resource.
- Paid awakening is not enabled in this release; v1.2.4 only prepares its economy configuration for a later release.
- Manual in-game runtime validation covered x1/x5/x10/x100 purchases, insufficient balance, duplicate compensation, immediate GUI synchronization, collection limits, legacy pricing, and unchanged awakening behavior.
- Feature, develop, and main CI validation completed successfully before release preparation.
- Updated the mod version metadata to `1.2.4`.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.4.jar`.
